randomizer-complete-edition-v0.6.jar.why: Fixes its crafting table recipe, which uses recipe syntax 1.21.1 can't read.

mob_mutator-1.0.0.jar.why: Removes its title screen mixin, which forces an editor button onto the pack's title screen.

Structory_Towers_26.2_v1.0.17.jar.why: Declares it a data-only mod (lowcodefml), which NeoForge 1.21.1 needs to load it.

SecurityCraft-1.21.1-v1.10.2.1.jar.why: Removes its camera ChunkMap mixin, which crashes on world load next to Immersive Portals (needed by the Portal Gun).

farmersrespite-1.21.1-3.0.1-dyefix.jar.why: Fixes its red dye recipe, which uses recipe syntax 1.21.1 can't read.

ars_nouveau-1.21.1-5.13.2.jar.why: Leaves out its bundled LambDynamicLights API, which conflicts with the pack's mods.

fancymenu_neoforge_3.9.14_MC_1.21.1.jar.why: One-byte change that lets the pack's title screen lay out every button itself.

extract.why: The uranium A-10 uses MCHeli's own A-10 model, copied from the MCHeli jar on install.

dropped.Actually 3D Stuff.zip: The build the pack used is no longer published; the author's current versions are for Minecraft 1.21.9 and newer.
dropped.3d-mace.zip: Not published on Modrinth or CurseForge.
dropped.6actions-and-stuff-pumpkins.zip: Not published on Modrinth or CurseForge.
dropped.Better illagers FA.zip: Its author only allows downloads from CurseForge itself.
dropped.Better Trident v2.zip: Its author only allows downloads from CurseForge itself.
dropped.HMI_Alittle_Axolotl.zip: Not published on Modrinth or CurseForge.

manualNotes.mcheli-modern-port: Its author only allows downloads from CurseForge itself, so this one has to be downloaded by hand.

personal.txfastload-neoforge-*.jar: NeoForge port of TxFastLoad made with the author's permission for personal use; stays out of the public pack until distribution is cleared.
